question: Why do powers immersed in Shiva not become cosmic eggs?
premises: An objection arises that powers immersed in Shiva might also be eggs.
A further statement is given to address this objection.
Those powers have not fallen from the state of power.
inference: Therefore powers immersed in Shiva are not eggs because they have not undergone the fall into manifestation.
uncertainties: cyutaśaktitaḥ is compact; the reading 'fallen from the state of power' follows the argument but is interpretive.
plain_english: One might object that powers immersed in Shiva should also be eggs, but they are not, because they have not fallen from their own state of power.
